overview.channel: The People Behind History's Greatest Turning Points
overview.youtube_title: Napoleon's Fatal Gamble: Why He Invaded Russia in 1812
overview.youtube_description: Why did Napoleon march into Russia? An archival-inspired paper-cut documentary exploring the decision and its tragic consequences. Illustrations are artistic reconstructions, not authentic archival footage.
overview.central_question: Why did Napoleon expect Russia to negotiate?
overview.historical_thesis: The 1812 invasion seriously weakened Napoleon's forces; the collapse of the empire followed further campaigns in 1813–1814.
overview.visual_style: Full-bleed paper-cut / archival engraving (no border or sticker outlines)

research.title: Napoleon invaded Russia in June 1812; later retreat losses had multiple causes
